meaning:
χάρτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Isa.8:1 A, Jer.36:2, 6 36:23 (מְגִלָּה) * ;]
a sheet of paper, made of papyrus strips (see Kennedy, Sources, 42; Milligan, NTD, 10-12; DB, iv, 945 f.): II Jn 12 (Plat., Inscr.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made…
